title: SA-RSQ: A Versatile Sparse Representation Framework for Multi-modal Recommender Systems
abstract: arXiv:2608.22979v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deploying high-dimensional multimodal features in industrial recommender systems incurs substantial storage and latency overhead. Hard quantization is compact but introduces boundary distortion, whereas dense soft quantization couples representation quality to the limited storage budget. We propose Sparse Activation-based Residual Soft Quantization (SA-RSQ), which uses Top-K sparse routing and softmax weights to store compact (Index, Probability) tuples. The stored tuples decouple per-item storage from codebook dimensionality; for a fixed selected support, gradients propagate through the routing weights and weighted reconstruction without relying on a straight-through estimator. Experiments on a proprietary food-delivery advertising dataset show favorable reconstruction-performance and CTR trade-offs across storage budgets of 8-48 bytes per item. A preliminary Next-Distribution Prediction study and a one-week online A/B test further demo

translated_title: SA-RSQ：一种面向多模态推荐系统的通用稀疏表示框架
translated_abstract: 在工业推荐系统中部署高维多模态特征会带来显著的存储和延迟开销。硬量化虽然紧凑，但会引入边界失真；而密集软量化则将表示质量与有限的存储预算耦合在一起。我们提出了一种基于稀疏激活的残差软量化（SA-RSQ）方法，该方法利用Top-K稀疏路由和softmax权重来存储紧凑的（索引，概率）元组。这些存储的元组将每个条目的存储量与码本维度解耦；对于固定的选定支持集，梯度通过路由权重和加权重建进行传播，无需依赖直通估计器。在专有的食品配送广告数据集上的实验表明，在每条目8-48字节的存储预算下，该方法在重建性能和点击率（CTR）之间取得了良好的权衡。一项初步的下一分布预测研究和为期一周的在线A/B测试进一步证明了其有效性。
tldr: 本文提出SA-RSQ框架，通过Top-K稀疏路由和残差软量化，以紧凑元组存储实现多模态推荐系统中存储效率与表示质量的解耦，并在工业数据上验证了其性能优势。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SA-RSQ, a sparse activation-based residual soft quantization framework that decouples storage from codebook dimensionality via compact tuple storage, achieving favorable reconstruction and CTR trade-offs in multimodal recommender systems.
